incidents.summary: An employee died in an incident involving machinery at Macfarlane’s Pitreavie site in October 2025; the machinery was replaced, and the authorities’ investigation remained ongoing in August 2026.

sources.title: Printweek - Macfarlane remains focused on profit recovery actions - Printweek
sources.quote: Macfarlane scrapped the corrugated device that was involved in the fatal incident at Pitreavie in October 2025 when an employee died.

sources.title: Printweek - Macfarlane remains focused on profit recovery actions - Printweek
sources.quote: It said the investigation by relevant authorities was ongoing, with no updates to report as yet on the likely outcome or potential fines.

sources.title: Printweek - Macfarlane remains focused on profit recovery actions - Printweek
sources.quote: The group subsequently invested £1.2m in a new four-colour Dong Fang Apstar printer/slotter/die-cutter, to return Pitreavie to full operational capacity ahead of the critical pre-Christmas peak period for food and drink customers in Scotland.
